hello.note: Reply: wuh-uh-LAY-koom us-suh-LAAM. Plain salaam also heard.

goodbye.note: 'Go in God's protection'; the standard parting line.

thank_you.note: Tashakor (Persian/Arabic loan) is a formal alternative.

youre_welcome.note: Lit. 'come again anytime'; bare har kala is the core form.

no_problem.note: 'There's no problem'; کومه خبره نه ده is a common variant.

please.note: Lotfan (Persian loan) is a shorter alternative.

excuse_me.note: For attention or pardon; distinct from the apology below.

sorry.note: Lit. 'I seek forgiveness'; متأسف یم (Persian loan) is softer.

of_course.note: Persian loan, common in Pashto media; هرو مرو is a thin alt.

amazing.note: 'That's perfect/excellent'; a warm note of admiration.

cheers.note: Literally 'good health'; the toast used when drinking.
